label: Ruijie Reyee RG-NBS3200-48GT4XS
description: Ruijie Reyee RG-NBS3200-48GT4XS - 52-port Layer 2+ managed switch: 48x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 and 4x 10GE SFP+ uplinks, no PoE. 176 Gbps switching capacity, 131 Mpps, two fixed fans, 1 GB RAM / 256 MB flash, 46.4 W maximum draw, 440 x 267.5 x 43.6 mm, 3.6 kg.
notes: Datasheet: 48 RJ45 + 4 x 10GE SFP+, "Module slots No", "Maximum power consumption 46.4 W", "RAM 1 GB" (the only member of the family with 1 GB; the rest carry 512 MB), "Flash memory 256 MB", "Fan 2 x fixed fans", 440 x 267.5 x 43.6 mm, 3.6 kg, shipped with 2 mounting brackets and 8 screws. Management is web/cloud only: the datasheet lists SSH "No", HTTP login "Yes", HTTPS login "Yes", eWeb, SNMPv1/v2c/v3 and Ruijie Cloud / Reyee App; there is no console port and no serial CLI in the datasheet, so no cli capability and no console interface. Layer 2+ software: "IEEE 802.1Q VLAN Yes", "LACP Yes", "STP/RSTP/MSTP Yes", "DHCP client Yes", "DHCP relay Yes", "DHCP server No", "IPv4 static route Yes", "IPv6 static route Yes" - static routes and relay, no dynamic routing protocol is listed. Port names ge1..geN / sfp1..sfpN / sfp+1..sfp+4 are the catalogue naming convention for a web-managed access switch; the datasheet states port counts, not names. The product page hero block prints "Forwarding Rate 132 Mpps" against the datasheet figure of 131 Mpps, and a "PoE Budget 370W" panel this non-PoE box does not have; the datasheet wins.
